title: confiture test-db provision-template --format json
description: The template database just built from DDL (or restored from --from-artifact) and stamped with the db/ content hash (TemplateStatus.to_dict, the same shape test-db status writes). A template that is written is current by construction, so state is always current and the two hashes are equal. A failure (refused clobber, failed build or restore) writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead.

name.description: The template database name given as --template.

state.description: Always current: the template was stamped with the hash it was built from.

stored_hash.description: The hash stamped on the template's database COMMENT: the SHA-256 hex digest of the db/ tree that SchemaBuilder.compute_hash() returns.

current_hash.description: The hash the template was built from; equal to stored_hash.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
